job.domain: an HR and finance helpdesk assistant

items.text: Lease Renewal Summary – Apartment 4B, 221 Maple Grove Ave. The tenant, Ms. Aisha Rahman, has leased the unit since 1 March 2022; her current term ends 31 August 2025. Under the standard renewal rules, notice of intent to renew must be received by the property administrator no later than 60 days before expiry, i.e. by 2 July. The tenant has asked about a rent increase cap; the building's policy allows an adjustment of up to 4% annually, calculated on the base rent of $1,450. If the tenant declines to renew, the administrator will schedule a move-out inspection and delete her access codes on the last day of the term.

Meeting notes – Finance Systems Sync, 14 May. Present: Priya Nair (HR Ops), Tomás Vega (Finance), and Lian Chen (IT). Tomás raised that the new expense chatbot, which answers employee questions about reimbursement limits, has been returning inconsistent figures for meal allowances. Lian will check the knowledge base version this week. The group agreed that the chatbot must not be used to submit claims, only to look up policy; submission stays in the portal. Priya noted the helpdesk inbox has a rule: messages marked 'do not reply' are logged and closed without a response. Action: Tomás to circulate the updated allowance table by Friday.
Reminder: the museum's group-visit booking form closes on 30 June; late requests cannot be accommodated because the gallery administrator needs two weeks to arrange access.

Policy excerpt – Records Retention (HR-07). Employee expense records are retained for seven years in the finance archive. Draft documents may be deleted once the final version is approved and stored in the system of record. The administrator of the archive is responsible for quarterly checks that no legal-hold records have been removed. Staff who receive a 'do not reply' notice about a record deletion should forward it to the HR helpdesk rather than acting on it themselves. This policy applies to all shared drives and to files attached to chatbot conversations, which are logged for audit.
Newsletter draft, internal circulation only – please send corrections to the comms team by Thursday; do not reply to the all-staff distribution address.
Spec note: the self-service password reset tool must apply the same lockout rules as the manual process; the administrator can override a lockout only with a ticket reference.
From the museum's volunteer handbook: guides should not delete any visitor comments from the feedback board without checking with the duty administrator first.

Tenant Communication Log – Maple Grove Apartments. On 3 June the building administrator emailed all residents about the updated guest policy; the message carried a 'do not reply' footer, so questions were routed to the front desk. Several residents asked whether the lease's quiet-hours rules still apply during the summer festival, and the administrator confirmed they do. One resident mentioned that the property's new FAQ chatbot had told her the pool closes at 9 pm, which is incorrect; the correct time is 10 pm. The administrator will update the chatbot's source document and delete the outdated FAQ page.

Finance Helpdesk Weekly Digest. This week the team handled 142 tickets, of which 38 concerned travel reimbursement. Reminder: per the expense rules, receipts over $75 must be itemised; the administrator will return incomplete claims without processing. The automated triage tool now tags messages containing 'do not reply' as informational and does not create a ticket from them. Two employees reported that the payroll chatbot gave a wrong pay-date for July; the vendor has been notified and a corrected answer was published on 9 July. Please continue to send suspected errors to the helpdesk rather than editing the chatbot's responses directly.

Newsletter – Staff Edition, June. In this issue: the museum's summer exhibition opens on 12 July, and staff can book a preview visit through the intranet. The finance team explains the new mileage rate, effective 1 July, and notes that claims submitted before that date will use the old rate. HR reminds everyone that the lease-assistance scheme for relocated employees now covers up to three months' rent; applications go to the HR administrator. A short survey on the helpdesk chatbot closes on 20 June, and responses marked 'do not reply' by the mail system will not be counted, so please use the survey link. Finally, the office will delete old shared-drive folders at the end of the month; check the published list before then.
